about: Text around the cursor for the vocab-en set's context mode: for each sentence, an earlier message in the same thread, as a person would have written it, that uses the sentence's terms (and sometimes others). The runners extract terms from it with the apps' own ContextTerms and decode with no custom vocabulary. `unrelated` is the text used for every clip of the other sets, to check that a field full of names does not cost accuracy on speech that uses none of them. Written by hand.
